LOSS.description: AAT carries information that parser-IR has no field for.

INVENTION.description: parser-IR requires a value that AAT does not supply.

AMBIGUITY.description: Same concept exists in both schemas but with different semantics or range.

UNSUPPORTED.description: AAT node kind has no parser-IR representation.
